big_nukes.guide.uranium.text:
Uranium ore lies deep, below y=16, in stone and deepslate. Mine it with an iron pickaxe or better: it drops raw uranium.

Raw uranium is too weak for a bomb. Enrich it in a centrifuge first.
big_nukes.guide.centrifuge.text:
Craft it from a furnace, iron ingots, glass and redstone.

Put raw uranium in the upper slot and fuel in the lower one: coal, wood or lava. Every 20 seconds it spins out one enriched uranium.

4 enriched uranium in the upper slot make one weapons-grade uranium, every 60 seconds. The Sunbreaker's core needs it.

Hoppers feed it and empty it, as they do a furnace.
big_nukes.guide.assembly.text:
Craft the assembly table from a crafting table ringed with eight iron ingots.

Bombs and their parts are made only here. Put a recipe's parts anywhere in the grid and press Assemble.
big_nukes.guide.bombs.text:
Demolition charge: radius 16, no radiation.

Tactical warhead: radius 50 and weak radiation that fades away.

Atomic bomb: radius 250 and a zone that stays radioactive.

A bomb goes off only through its detonator. A blast's wave sets off every bomb it reaches.

Sunbreaker: the largest bomb, built where it stands. Place its core, close it in 26 implosion shells (the 3x3x3 cube round it), then wrap those in 98 neutron reflectors (the surface of the 5x5x5 cube). A whole shell gives radius 600, and each reflector adds its share, up to 1000. At 1000 the blast breaks through the bedrock at its center and leaves a hole into the void. Without a whole shell it doesn't go off. It is read when it goes off: break a part and it is weaker.

Right-click any block of it to reach the core: it takes any detonator, and with an empty hand it tells you its shell, its reflector and its radius. Its fuse burns 15 seconds, an alarm sounding over the last 5. You won't outrun radius 1000 on foot. Missiles and bombers can't carry it.
big_nukes.guide.detonators.text:
Place a bomb, then right-click it with a detonator to put it in.

Fuse: light the bomb with flint and steel and run, you have 4 seconds. The demolition charge takes only a fuse.

Keypad: right-click the bomb with an empty hand. The first code you type, 3 to 8 digits, becomes its code. The right code sets it off in 5 seconds; three wrong ones lock the keypad for 30 seconds.
big_nukes.guide.remote.text:
Put a receiver detonator in a bomb, then right-click the bomb with a remote to link them. The remote's tooltip names its bomb.

Go as far as you like, aim at the sky and right-click: the bomb goes off, even in another dimension. Aimed at a block, the remote does nothing.
big_nukes.guide.carriers.text:
Missile: a launch pad at the bottom of a shaft, at least 6 blocks of air over it, and a silo hatch on top with open sky above. Put a missile from the assembly table and a tactical warhead or an atomic bomb in the pad's two slots.

Place a launch console within 8 blocks of the pad and right-click it. Type the target's X and Z and a code of 3 to 8 digits, on the keyboard or with its buttons: Tab moves between the fields, Enter launches. The code of the console's first launch becomes its code; three wrong codes lock it for 30 seconds. The target is 100 to 4096 blocks away.

After a 5 second countdown the hatch opens and the missile climbs out in smoke. A camera follows it for the one who launched; the Camera button turns it off. The missile comes down on the target and goes off there, even far from any player.

Bomber: place a strike beacon and right-click it with a tactical warhead or an atomic bomb. 30 seconds later a bomber flies over, 120 blocks up, and drops the bomb on the beacon. Stand clear! Break the beacon before the drop and you get the bomb back.

The operator's /bignukes maxpower limit holds for both.
big_nukes.guide.radiation.text:
Big blasts leave a radioactive zone. Inside it your dose builds up: from 100 rad you grow weak and hungry, from 300 sick, from 600 very sick, and 1000 rad kills. Out of the zone the dose slowly falls.

A Geiger counter in your hand clicks and shows the background and your dose.

The full hazmat suit keeps 95% out and wears down in a zone. Anti-rad takes 300 rad off.

Iodine tablets, eaten before you go in, keep 50% of the radiation out for 5 minutes, with the suit or without it. Another tablet makes it 5 minutes again.

The decontaminator is made at the assembly table. It burns any furnace fuel 4 times as fast as a furnace, and while it burns its circle grows a block every 2 seconds, up to 48: the background inside falls to nothing and comes back over 8 blocks past the edge, and the ash on open ground turns back to grass. What it cleaned stays clean without fuel and after the block is broken, but a new blast brings the radiation back, and the decontaminator starts again from its center.

A bunker keeps out the blast and the radiation. Where no daylight reaches, under ground or in a shut house, the background is halved. Reinforced concrete holds a demolition charge anywhere and a tactical warhead at its crater's edge; armored concrete holds an atomic bomb away from the center of its crater. A wall the wave can't hold cracks first and then breaks, and a cracked wall holds half. Concrete, a lead shield, a blast damper and concrete again, four in a row out from the blast, hold as one multilayer wall, even against a sunbreaker away from its center. Under the crater's floor the wave touches nothing, and a wall that holds keeps what is under it.

The fuel generator burns furnace fuel twice as long as a furnace and powers air filters and bunker lamps within 16 blocks. A powered air filter goes round its room every 5 seconds: shut by walls and closed doors, with up to 4096 blocks of air and no gap to the sky, the room is sealed and lets in only 5% of the radiation. The hermetic door opens by hand or with redstone, and rations feed you through the long wait.
big_nukes.guide.commands.text:
Stand at least 400 blocks away when an atomic bomb goes off.

/bignukes guide gives you this book.

For operators:
/bignukes blast <radius> [x y z] sets off a blast.
/bignukes maxpower [16|50|250|1000|1024] limits how big a blast may be.

big_nukes.tip.decontaminator: Put fuel in it: it cleans a growing circle of up to 48 blocks of radiation and turns ash back to grass.
